_about: Level links (stair flights and sewer ladders) taken direct: the runner reaches the connection and the level changes on that frame, with no fade, no hold and no climb wait. Read by game/transition.rs. prefetch_distance is how close (cells) the runner gets to a stair or ladder landing before the storey it leads to is built ahead (game/endless.rs prefetch_connections), so the change on the connection's frame builds nothing.landing_offset is how far in from the far landing's cell the runner is put on arrival (cells); flight_steps is the cells from the near landing to the far one. Godot reference: game/world/generation/stairwells.gd (landing and flight cells), game/infinite_route/infinite_route_test.gd (_update_player_ladder, _on_player_ladder_finished).
